title: Verify mobile News reader and remove thumbnail prompt copy
question: Can the mobile News reader keep images and all controls usable while removing the visible thumbnail hint text?
acceptance_criteria: TW and US mobile pages load data without persistent loading blocks.
Mobile stock search/selection and Chinese/English controls remain usable.
Visible Article thumbnail and 文章縮圖 prompt text is removed while image alt text and fallback behavior remain.
RSS/data gateway, story ordering and source-link behavior are unchanged.
The merged Pages deployment is verified on both custom-domain routes.
